question: With the five right-sizing policies on together (rt_capture_peak_reserve, rt_capture_demand_size, rt_capture_split_mb, rt_mesh_pool_trim, rt_as_chunk_fit), how many MB do our pools reserve for the same use, and does anything get left out, reallocated more often or slower than with them off?
evidence: User play logs of 2026-11-14 22:12-22:27 (Ultra, RTX Hair On): ours 10.2-12.6 GB of 23-27.5 GB used, budget 30 GB. Live logs hq-s8-ultra 215258 and hq-inn-fix 211816. Offline replays: CTests as_chunk_alloc_test, rt_capture_elastic_test, rt_capture_budget_test, vram_compact_test.
design: One launch per scene (vr-s8, vr-inn), Ultra, RTX Hair On, FG 3x, visible_unfocused_fg. States off-a / on / off-b, all five keys toggled live. Per state: static, pan Q, pan E back, wheel dolly out, wheel dolly in, then a static energy window (exposure held, 4 float traces). The '[mem] pools reserved/used MB' line (detailed_logging) carries every pool and the keys' state once per 120-frame window.
noise_rule: Every threshold is the OFF repeat of the same run: noise(metric) = |off-b - off-a| of the same window kind. A reserved-MB difference below it is not a finding. Frame time and FG presentation are not judged from an occluded window (GPU ms, MB and log lines only).

predicted.cascade_capture: ON 3 slots at demand + max(25%, 107 MB) each; OFF demand + 147 MB and the learned rise on top of the high level. S8 static: 0 to -120 MB (3 x 40 MB of preset reserve). After the pans and the dolly (a learned rise): -300 to -826 MB (replay: 1044 -> 769 MB per slot at the high level).
predicted.rt_capture: OFF never below 1408 MB, 1600-2047 MB after a pan. ON: need + max(25%, 256 MB): S8 static 700-1100 MB, inn 900-1400 MB; -300 to -700 MB (replay: mean 1787 -> 1485 MB, low level 1408 -> 768 MB). The shrink needs 120 low samples: it shows in the static and energy windows, not inside a pan.
predicted.blas_chunks: ON: empty chunks 0-200 MB where OFF shows 100-1400 MB after a pan or dolly (replay of the S8 event: 1316 -> 160 MB); reserved - live lower by 300-1100 MB in the moving windows, equal in the static ones (the empty chunks leave after 120 frames in both).
predicted.mesh_pool: ON: one 'trimmed ... at the same offsets' line per state at most, in a static window, only if the pool grew above its need before (the pans of the OFF-a state): then -25% or more. No trim (0 MB) is a valid outcome when the pool's end is in use; the deferral line says so.
predicted.total: ON lower than the OFF mean by 0.7-2.0 GB of tracked MB in the moving windows of S8 and the inn, 0.3-0.9 GB in the static ones. VRAM used follows by the same amount (the game's and the core's share is unchanged).
predicted.faults: 0 in every state: no VK_ERROR_DEVICE_LOST, no crash, guard never LOW (budget 30 GB, use under 24 GB).
predicted.left_out: 'opaque draws dropped (buffer full)' and cascade 'buffer full' 0.00 in every static window of every state. In the first ON pan or dolly after the shrink a cut may leave draws out for up to 5 frames (the stated cost bound: under 0.05 per frame over a 120-frame period); the OFF pans have 0.00. More than that, or any in a static window, is a FAIL for rt_capture_demand_size.
predicted.reallocations: ON: at most 4 more '[geo] RT capture capacity A -> B' lines per state than OFF (replay: 9 against 8 up, 2 against 2 down), none in a static window after its first 240 frames (no thrash). BLAS chunk allocations per window lower with ON.
predicted.frame_time: GPU pass ms (rt passes, GI, scene build, RR) ON equal to OFF within noise: no policy changes GPU work. Scene wait max and [pace] max: a replacement frame may add a few ms once; p99 unchanged. Reported, judged only when the window was not occluded.
predicted.energy: Static camera, exposure held: the ON mean of the normalized scene colour inside the OFF samples' range (no policy changes shading; a draw left out of the RT scene in a static view would show here).

decision: Each policy becomes a default candidate if reserved MB falls beyond noise with left-out counts and GPU ms equal to OFF. A policy whose pool shows no saving stays off (no harm, no gain). Any device loss or a static-window drop: off, and the cause first.
not_measured_here: The per-reallocation cost in ms (needs a dedicated trace), the pixel-LOD camera BLAS compaction (not implemented), rt_as_cap_occupied (stays 0: it raises the reserve).
